name: Consistent garbage listing
note: residual: consistent garbage passes integrity; bond/fingerprint are off-chain

name: Inconsistent commitment
note: inconsistent plaintext/ciphertext proof refunds the buyer

name: Wrong key delivery
note: mode-2 response rejects a key that does not match cK

name: Key before payment
note: no key material before payment; wrapped key posted at delivery

name: Re-initialisation
note: no initializer; constructor wires the contracts

name: Price change after deposit
note: price is snapshotted at buy; registry change has no effect

name: De-listed asset trading
note: buy reverts on an inactive asset

name: Overpayment stranding
note: exact msg.value required; no stranded excess

name: Refund wiping
note: state guards reject confirm/deliver after a refund

name: .transfer griefing
note: call{value:} pays gas-heavy receivers

name: False integrity dispute
note: a false claim forfeits the buyer bond

name: Fabricated chunk proof
note: a leaf not rooted in R_D/R_C reverts

name: Dispute spam
note: buyer bond is forfeited, not prevention; seller is not paid extra

name: Leak-by-dispute
note: residual: K is public after a mode-2 dispute

name: Seller stalls after dispute
note: timeoutRespond refunds after T_respond

name: Buyer stalls confirmation
note: timeoutConfirm pays the seller after T_confirm

name: Timestamp manipulation
note: window constants; boundary behaves at T+/-15s

name: Reentrancy on payout
note: reentrant confirm is rejected by nonReentrant

name: Late-respond time-bar
note: respond extends T_confirm by 1 day; timeoutConfirm blocked and buyer disputes Mode 1

name: Mode-2 re-challenge loop
note: max one Mode-2 challenge per sale; second disputeMode2 reverts with AlreadyChallenged
